question: A container holds 70 litres of a milk water mixture in which water makes up 10\% of the total. How many litres of pure water should be added so that the proportion of water in the mixture increases to 25\%?
solution:

Initial quantity of mixture = 70 litres

Target percentage of water in the mixture = 25%
